neighbours.label: praise that an arrangement is rationally worked out: 'well designed', 'carefully planned', 'scientific and reasonable' said of a layout, schedule or structure (also Chinese 科学/合理); 'designed' as a plain action and 'reasonable' of a price stay quiet
fire: The floor plan of the clinic is well designed, so nurses never have to walk far.
Visitors praised the route as sensibly planned, with rest stops at even intervals.
The structure of the curriculum is scientific and reasonable, moving from simple to hard.
Storage in the warehouse is rationally arranged, which shortens every picking trip.
The interface is thoughtfully designed and every button sits where you expect it.
Thanks to a properly planned rota, the ward was never short of staff.
The division of work between the two teams is reasonable and well organized.
Engineers called the drainage scheme carefully designed and scientifically laid out.
quiet: The floor plan of the clinic is pinned to the wall next to the front desk.
Visitors praised the route for its views of the lake and the old mill.
The curriculum was printed last week and handed to the new teachers.
Storage in the warehouse costs about four dollars a pallet each month.
My sister designed a logo for the bakery over the weekend.
The hotel rate was reasonable, so we stayed one more night.
The two teams met on Tuesday and argued about the budget.
Engineers visited the drainage site on Monday and took some photographs.

notes: Card: ' designed', ' planned', ' reasonable', 科学, 合理, no single token. Probes: 'well designed' 0.41, 'scientific and reasonable' 0.57, 'sensible split' 0.43; 'She designed a poster' 0.01, 'price seemed reasonable' 0.09.
